semantics: Each computed measure is costed on the replay's certified model and data, holding the rest of the law at what that engine treats as current law. A reversal_on_certified_world measure is in current law: its baseline world undoes it (baseline_world.submitted_reform) and its reform world is current law. A forward_delta_on_certified_world measure is not in current law: its baseline world is current law and its reform world adds it (reform_world.submitted_reform). measure_total_gbp is the sum of the declared fiscal heads' Exchequer effects, positive meaning a gain to the Exchequer; replay year Y is calendar year Y, the proxy for fiscal year Y-(Y+1). These are not the estimates made at the time of the event.
